repo_notes.content: This repository contains the entire implementation of Arbitrum Nitro, a second-generation Layer 2 blockchain protocol.

You should use docs and whitepapers / pdf documents as the general source of information on how the protocol works and the role of various components. You can find most docs in arbitrum-docs/ but also the whitepaper under docs/Nitro-whitepaper.pdf and more docs in bold/docs/.
Use cmd/chaininfo/arbitrum_chain_info.json for information about chains and contracts but docs take precedence. For example, the rollup address is correct in the docs but wrong in that file
Ignore development and operations aspects and focus only on actual logic of the node
